verdicts.evidence: Numerical experiments on policy distributions show the objective is non-linear under BoN transforms (chord gap [1.03e-4, 8.14e-2] vs 2.22e-16 for linear), and the IAMA base policy achieves higher Eq.(1) value than naive in 60/60 conflicting-reward instances; mutation with N=1 collapses the non-linearity as predicted.

Functional derivative matches finite differences to max rel error 7.33e-8 over 80 cases; replacing only the reward vector in standard GRPO reaches the true non-linear optimum (max suboptimality 5.55e-16 over 30 instances); empirical π̂ approximation error scales as M^{-1.024}; mutation with plain reward is strictly worse in 30/30 instances.

Across 90 instances and 2250 bound evaluations, zero violations above 1e-12; max excess loss at T=25 is 2.04e-6; mutations with wrong step size (η=20/L) or plain reward produce 21/36 and 36/36 violations respectively, confirming the guarantee is specific to the stated update.

Across 60 configs with 200 runs each, the full bound including 2(ε+δ)/β is never violated (max ratio 0.2611); dropping the additive term causes violations in 36/36 noisy configs (max ratio 1.65e10); plateau grows monotonically with noise in 12/12 cells.

Sympy confirms the claimed density integrates to 1; first-order optimality at π* holds to machine precision (relative span ~0 for N=2,3,4,8,16); naive weighted-sum puts mass 1.0 at y≈0.5 vs 0.922 bimodal mass for IAMA N=8; mutation with α=1/N instead of 1/(N−1) breaks optimality (span jumps to 0.162).

No experiments were run; the logbook reports blocking factors including GPU-cluster scale for 7B RL training, unreleased author-trained reward models and judges, no public code, and no numeric table behind Fig. 6b to re-assert.

overall: The logbook provides thorough numerical verification of the paper's five mathematical claims—objective formulation, algorithm design, two convergence theorems, and the bimodal-policy proposition—using synthetic policy distributions with mutation tests and independent solver cross-checks. The sole empirical claim (HH-RLHF/Alpaca-7B Pareto front) is honestly reported as unreproduced due to GPU scale and unreleased artifacts.
